reviews.text: Fantastic service & such a pleasure to deal with! Highly recommend.

I brought my nervous Pomeranian into Tom today for the first time and it was a wonderful experience. She seemed so chill when I picked her up, and you could just tell she was well cared for by someone who loves dogs! A gorgeous grooming studio with a lovely calming environment. She is already booked in for a revisit!
Tom so kind and gentle with my nervous dog always looks fab after his groom.  Thank you Tom.
Our 4 months old westie puppy got his first grooming today! Tom is an amazing groomer, he did such a nice job 🥰 I’m obsessed with our boy’s new hair cut! Definitely recommended 💯💯💯
Excellent job as usual ☺️
Ozzie came out very happy and looked fantastic
Thank you 🙌🏻 …

Had our 1st visit with Tom today for our pug Loki. Really struggled to find a groomer who gives a great wash, deshed, nails, glands etc. and who Loki would be comfortable with. Absolutely no need to look any further, by far the best groom he has ever had, he left super clean and soft and most of all happy. Tom went through in detail what he planned to do and took Lokis allergies into consideration during the consult.
I cannot recommend the salon enough, the care and attention is so plain to see and bonus for a gorgeous salon and super clean!
Excellent as always 😊 …
Brilliant service from Tom as always.
Pebble's second trip to Tom and can't get over what a fabulous job he does, and so lovely to deal with, delighted we found Tom, a true professional!
Quality,quality,quality
Tom is an amazing groomer. He does such a great job on our mini schnauzer Evie, she always looks so stylish and fresh when shes done 😍 …
Tom did a brilliant job on Dolly as always. Thank you!

Brought my puppy to WAGD for his 5th groom in search of a groomer that has it all, looking no further! I wanted him to feel calm, happy and cared for as well as being checked thoroughly and beautifully groomed. Bonus points for a gorgeous, high standard and clean salon.
Thank you 🙌🏻 …

Just picked up my Yorkie Rosie  from Tom, always so pleased how she's groomed.
Tom is such a fantastic groomer,   so kind.  I wouldn't want to leave her with anyone else.  Well worth the journey from Wicklow....

Great Groomers Charlie looks amazing as always, Thanks Tom.

Again as always Tom Charlie looks fabulous Thankyou so much 🩵 …
Had a springer and a cockapoo for grooming..Beautiful job particularly on the cockapoo who really needed it. Very knowledgeable ,kind  and professional staff.

Many thanks to Tom in Who's A Good Dog for looking after Obi as always! We chose to cut his coat for the winter and Tim did a fantastic job giving him the cleanest and sleekest shave he still looks so handsome defloofed 😍
I can't recommend Tom enough he makes sure every dog in his care has a stress free time as possible while putting a lot of work into making them look furbulous 🙌

Tom has a really warm welcoming personality with a lot of experience. Love how he takes his time and is thorough. My dog is super clean and smells so good after a very overdue visit. Thank you so much
Would highly recommend Tom. Extremely knowledgeable and gentle with my 2 dogs.
Honestly the best groomer my dogs have ever been to.

I’ve been taking Harper to Tom for the past couple of months and couldn’t be happier with the service. Tom is so accommodating with appointment times and collections! Her cut has never looked better and even with a longer style she’s easy to keep brushed!
Such a great experience with Tom. He did an amazing job grooming our dog Bailey. She came home just like a teddy bear and she is already booked back in for her next groom.

Mabel, my 4 year old  English Cocker Spaniel happily returned to Who’s a Good Dog for her second full groom today with Tom.  Tom collaborated with me clearly before and after the appointment to ensure Mabel’s grooming needs were met not just today but also supported in the weeks ahead of her next Who’s a Good Dog appointment - outstanding professional service🙏🏻
Really happy with Chip fresh look. Tom is great with him & create relaxing environment. Would highly recommend
Excellent groomer! Could not recommend more. Looked after my 2 dachshunds with such care.
Great experience at WHO’S A GOOD DOG?! Our dog Coco came out happy and shiny. Will certainly be back, highly recommended.
Our pup was only delighted to stay for her grooming and was happy out and looking gorgeous when we picked her up. Beautiful premises also
Fantastic always does a great job 👏 …
Thanks so much
We are really happy with this service. They did a brilliant groom on our English Cocker Spaniel. Would recommend.
Thanks so much 😊 …
Excellent service. Really knows what he is doing and gives my dog the best care and attention. Also gives me some great advice and is always happy to help when I have a question. Thanks so much!
Tom is THE goto guy for a professional "Master" grooming. A total Gentleman to deal with, so caring and you know your dog will be well looked after and done properly,.
Tom provides an excellent service and I would have no hesitation in recommending him to other dog lovers.
As always Cody received the best treatment from Tom and is chilling out now looking so clean and healthy

Lost for words. Tom was welcoming,friendly and so professional from the moment I met him. It was Millies first time visiting and she settled in immediately. I can't recommend Tom enough.And I also got to meet the handsome Niklaus 🥰❤ beautiful. Fantastic experience 👏 …
A great cut for my dog , even with a challenging matting tom was able to get it out and make him look great.
